title: IRC: TOPIC answers 482 'not operator' to an op; say why, or let TOPIC rename the room
description: Found driving irssi 1.4.3 (2026-11-21). An op's TOPIC #c gets 482 'The agent changes no room metadata'. 482 means 'You're not channel operator', which is wrong for an op and confusing. Either answer with a fitting numeric/notice, or map TOPIC to a room name change (RoomMetaData name, room-policy canChangeRoomName) since the topic shows 'name | room URI'. Needs Mark's choice.
